final: WITH equipment_avg AS (SELECT equipref, AVG(humepct) AS avg_humidity FROM scanenvironment GROUP BY equipref), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_humidity) AS mean_humidity FROM equipment_avg), kept AS (SELECT e.equipref, e.avg_humidity, o.mean_humidity FROM equipment_avg e CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE e.avg_humidity > o.mean_humidity), scored AS (SELECT equipref, avg_humidity, avg_humidity - mean_humidity AS above_overall_mean, avg_humidity - AVG(avg_humidity) OVER () AS difference_from_kept_mean FROM kept), ranked AS (SELECT *, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST) AS position FROM scored WHERE avg_humidity IS NOT NULL AND above_overall_mean IS NOT NULL AND difference_from_kept_mean IS NOT NULL) SELECT equipref, avg_humidity, above_overall_mean, difference_from_kept_mean FROM ranked WHERE position <= 10 ORDER BY difference_from_kept_mean DESC NULLS LAST
